title: Prove a universal P112 mixed-rank common-cut32 contract
body:
## Summary

```text
ONE arbitrary P112 common cut <=32
three residual binary support ranks <=5,6,6
  near equality forces singleton10/18
  pinned PR3295 concentration puts all pieces on two axes
  union82: coverage<=49, required>=50
  union84: coverage<=51, required>=52
restricted-code intersection dimension <=1
```

Add one conditional shortening theorem and a small exact replay package. The inherited uniform rank-six contract allows29 cuts; this mixed-rank implication allows32 over every characteristic-zero field, with arbitrary coefficients and possibly dependent pieces.

PR3295 at `4cff8128f0f9ea1e61515b95ddbb884366e9362c` supplies the concentration premise and already excludes the historical `4,5^3,6^6` caller. This contribution claims no new caller exclusion or sharpness. Its exact proof and two receipts are retained verbatim, so fresh CI does not require pending Git objects. Capacity, E6 joint, geometry/concentration/transport and Weyl premises remain inherited and unrun.

Credit PR3295/3278/3267/3260/3262/3269, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 lineage. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19004309). Open next questions and the one-result stopping decision are included.

## Evidence

- Before: the uniform rank-six cut29 theorem applies, while PR3295 proves a different six-piece/caller statement. After: the new arbitrary-cut32 implication has strict D6 coverage gaps of one and an E6 incidence gap of six, conditional on its stated premises.
- Registered CPython3.12 replay, a separate91,728-case occupancy check, optimized behavioral/source/type controls, Ruff E/F/B/I and formatting pass. All15 source-commit package/input bytes, official export integrity and all three actual committed read-only Git-free replay commands pass.
- Designated read-only peer inspected the actual proof/code/source/export, verified all15 hashes before and after, and passed all three optimized CPython3.12 commands with no blocking finding. Its verbatim receipt is retained in REVIEW.json. Internal computational review is narrower than human or proof-kernel approval.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-mixed566-cut32
```

No inherited heavy census, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, human or proof-kernel review was performed. No full C5, global decoder floor, physical/native/restoration/consumer construction, supplier, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only one new opt-in research package. Frozen predecessors and selected science are unchanged. Source authentication does not establish the inherited mathematics.
